howToPlay: Focus on landing your initial shots to charge up your powerful Big Sting. Use your slowing Super and gadgets to control space and keep enemies at a distance while you deal high damage.
gears: Damage is essential for increasing her high output, while Shield helps her survive since she has low health. Speed is also a great choice for better mobility.
trait: This marksman is perfect for players who enjoy precision aiming and managing high-stakes shots.
